name: Paper Strike
storyline: Paper Strike takes place in a floating world of ink and steel, with colourful arenas and living pages. Its warrior mages, known as Strikers, are trained at the Academy of Ink and Steel.
summary: Paper Strike is an online 3v3 fantasy party arena game in which players control warrior mages known as Strikers. Players trace predefined runes with the mouse to cast spells and combine them with instant physical abilities. Drawing requires standing still, and physical attacks can interrupt a cast. Before a match, players choose their abilities: Arin has eight abilities arranged in four pairs, with one ability selected for each slot. Teams compete in short rounds to control a zone in King of the Hill, collect crystals in Crystal Rush, or defeat opposing Strikers in Team Deathmatch. The full game is being developed around an Armageddon progression system. Both teams start at a central shrine; winning a round grants control of Armageddon and the choice of the next arena. Teams aim to advance this powerful spell to the opposing end of the battlefield.
